authority: owner order 2026-10-10 section 9 (compiled profile): bounded successor experiment registered before any new result; registered limits 0.5 % mean relative loss and 0.3 % final bpb preserved
design: one matched eager/compiled pair of 1,000 optimizer updates each on the launch basis: full v0.2.2 train stream (shards.json 1cf5e2320ad35e930f84ca0edbf5a9d188a2f524702dc4623e492dab043e3aef, tokenizer 176a89e2197c24d3f024fbb60ce6f346635e7cba912b3579d93b37d486c9adf1), exact-epoch horizon 52,034 updates (limit_tokens 3,410,100,225), warmup 500, peak LR 0.0016971, cosine min ratio 0.1, seed 1, micro-batch 16 x accumulation 2 (65,536 targets/update), bf16 autocast, fused AdamW, flash SDPA (default), --stop-at 1000, newly initialised weights (same seed), identical batches (verified by batch_fp at every update). The pair therefore reproduces the first 1,000 updates of the launch data order and schedule; it is qualification work, not the production canary (own run ids, checkpoints not reused).
compare_range_rationale: post-warmup updates; the whole range 1..1000 is also reported (stability) but the mean criterion is registered on 501..1000

domains.rule: every validation source with at least 700,000 scored bytes (the protocol-18b critical set) must have final bpb within 0.5 % between the runs; others are reported

compile_options.flags: torch.compile(model, mode='default'); no CUDA graphs; same SDPA backend as eager

seed_policy: single pair at the launch seed 1; no seed selection; the result of this pair is the decision
retry_policy: no rerun of a completed run; a run that fails for infrastructure reasons (pod loss, OOM, non-zero exit without a trainer verdict) may be restarted once from scratch with the same arguments; partial records are kept beside the final ones

diagnostic.when: the pair FAILS any criterion and the funding contract admits it
diagnostic.what: one eager replicate with identical arguments (run id ce2-eager-rep) to measure the eager-vs-eager trajectory noise of the non-deterministic flash backward
diagnostic.use: attribution in the report only; it cannot promote the compiled profile and does not change the tolerances

promotion_rule: the compiled profile may be selected for the tranche only if this record is PASS AND the B17 startup measurement, the recovery suite and the supervision checks are re-run on the compiled profile AND an independent review approves; otherwise the tranche runs eager
checkpoints: written to the pod's container disk (/root/ckpt-ce2) at the launch cadence (500 updates / 900 s); qualification artefacts, not retained
evaluation: validation split only (2,576 documents, 12,311,466 scored bytes); the test split is untouched
reporting: measured end-to-end speed and cost of both runs including compilation, evaluation, logging and checkpointing (summary startup/first_step_s/tokens_per_s_median, bench_matrix status start/end)
